# Statusline

> Statusline is an independent open-source desktop companion for monitoring Codex, Antigravity's Google Gemini quota and Claude Code. Compatible mobile apps and widgets support Codex and Antigravity.

The desktop companion shows each provider's reported quota windows and reset times,
without treating absent data as available quota. Optional mobile synchronization
uses end-to-end encrypted snapshots. Statusline is not affiliated with, sponsored
by or endorsed by OpenAI, Google or Anthropic.

## Current provider support

- Codex: local signed-in Codex CLI or compatible desktop installation; reported weekly and short-window quota. Desktop, compatible mobile apps and widgets.
- Antigravity: selected official Desktop or compatible AGY CLI installation, signed in by the user. Google Gemini weekly and five-hour buckets only, not third-party model quotas. Desktop, compatible mobile apps and widgets.
- Claude Code: desktop quota via an opt-in connection to Claude Code's statusLine hook. It displays only rate-limit windows the session actually reports, after a response. No Claude Code view in mobile apps or widgets yet. Live verification is on macOS; Windows and Linux have automated coverage, with native validation pending.

Claude Code requires explicit activation in Companion. Its previous status line is
preserved and restored on disconnect. The bridge receives the session payload but
retains reported rate-limit metadata (including a gateway spend limit when present)
and capture times, not transcripts or workspace content. Gateway spend is not a
quota window and stays local. It does not read Claude credentials, run prompts or call Claude endpoints.
Plan windows vary by session; API-key and cloud-provider sessions do not report
subscription quota. Usage reported by another device is not visible until a new
Claude Code report arrives. Missing windows are never inferred.

Mobile support depends on the installed version. Codex and Antigravity support
is implemented in the current repository; older apps may show Codex only, and
store releases can lag behind source. Claude Code remains desktop-only. Widgets
show cached samples and update on schedules controlled by iOS or Android, not in
real time. The website's screenshots predate multi-provider support and show
independent Codex demo examples, not connected accounts.

## Website

- [Statusline — English](https://statusline.inmerzion.io/): Project overview, features and download links.
- [Statusline — Español](https://statusline.inmerzion.io/es/): Project overview in Spanish.

## Project and documentation

- [iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/statusline/id6807851320): Free on the App Store for iPhone with iOS 17 or later. Native app and home screen widgets.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline): Source code and project overview.
- [Releases](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/releases): Published downloads and release notes.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/docs/README.md): Architecture, operations, release and security documentation.
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/SETUP.md): Installation and configuration instructions in Spanish.
- [Codex source](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/docs/architecture/codex-sources.md): Local runtime and supported discovery paths.
- [Antigravity integration](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/docs/architecture/antigravity-companion.md): Gemini collection, source selection and encrypted mobile delivery. Historical release sections have narrower scope.
- [Claude Code source](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/docs/architecture/claude-sources.md): Opt-in bridge, quota availability, privacy and platform verification boundaries.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/LICENSE): License terms for the project.

Android is in beta, with APKs available on GitHub Releases. Google Play is in
closed testing; no public availability date is promised here.

## Support and privacy

- [Support](https://statusline.inmerzion.io/support): Public support information.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arvivares/statusline/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): Installation, pairing and usage troubleshooting.
- [Privacy policy](https://statusline.inmerzion.io/privacy): Data handling, encrypted synchronization and retention.
